policy: Only report a source as active when it is actually accessible to the discovery mechanism used.

source_classes.name: Public job APIs
source_classes.coverage: Global/remote where the API exposes matching roles

source_classes.name: Employer career sites and ATS pages
source_classes.coverage: Search and verify the original employer/ATS posting before application

source_classes.name: Major job boards
source_classes.coverage: Use only when the current search mechanism can access the listing; never claim exhaustive board coverage

source_classes.name: Specialist/government sources
source_classes.coverage: Search where accessible and applicable; clearance/citizenship requirements must be explicitly verified

source_classes.name: Recruiters and specialist cybersecurity firms
examples: cybersecurity staffing and specialist recruitment firms
source_classes.coverage: Treat recruiter listings as leads and verify the end employer and application source

verification_rules: Prefer the original employer or official ATS URL.
Record the source URL and canonical application URL separately.
Do not infer visa sponsorship from location, job-board labels, or recruiter assumptions.
Label sponsorship Confirmed, Unclear, or Not offered with evidence.
If a board blocks access, record that limitation rather than claiming coverage.
